title: An honest report minimizes expected loss
hook: Two stated cases: explore the reported probability under a stipulated belief.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the reported probability under a stipulated belief affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Loss, regardless of the stated inputs.
